title.description: The name of the page listing what happened in the viewer's projects over the last seven days, in the platform header.

loading.description: What a screen reader hears while the This week page is still loading its projects.

range.description: The dates the This week page covers, at the top of the page. {{from}} and {{to}} are short dates such as 2 Nov.

wentLiveCount_one.description: On the This week page, the summary line. {{count}} is how many changes went live in the viewer's projects this week.

wentLiveCount_other.description: On the This week page, the summary line. {{count}} is how many changes went live in the viewer's projects this week.

inProjects_one.description: On the This week page, after the count of changes: how many projects they were in. {{count}} is that number of projects.

inProjects_other.description: On the This week page, after the count of changes: how many projects they were in. {{count}} is that number of projects.

wentLive.description: The grey line under a change on the This week page that went live. {{day}} is a short weekday such as Fri.

upForVote.description: The grey line under a change on the This week page that is still being voted on.

vote.description: The small blue pill on a change on the This week page that the viewer has not voted on yet.

more_one.description: The last line of a project's card on the This week page, opening its Workshop. {{count}} is how many more changes the week holds than the card lists.

more_other.description: The last line of a project's card on the This week page, opening its Workshop. {{count}} is how many more changes the week holds than the card lists.

empty.text: Nothing went live in your projects this week.
empty.description: What the This week page says when none of the viewer's projects had a change or an open vote in the last seven days.

error.text: Could not load your week. Try again.
error.description: What the This week page says when its projects could not be read.

retry.description: The button under that error that reads the This week page again.
